# SlateMind

> SlateMind is a free web app where an AI teacher writes each lesson on an animated blackboard, then quizzes the learner. It adds XP, levels, badges and daily streaks. It is early-stage and built by one student developer in Faridabad, India.

## What it does today
- Type any topic and watch a short lesson written in chalk handwriting, with headings, bullets, formulas and highlighted key ideas.
- Auto-generated 3-question quiz, glossary of key terms and a fun fact for each lesson.
- Follow-up questions about a topic (beta, still being improved).
- Gamification: levels, 16 badges, daily streaks, daily challenge.
- Save a lesson as a PNG. No account needed; progress is stored in the browser.

## Demo
- 54-second screen recording of the real app: https://slatemind-webpage.vercel.app/assets/demo.mp4 (sound effects only, no narration).

## Not available yet (planned)
CBSE chapter paths for Classes 9-12, Hindi/Hinglish lessons, accounts with progress sync, shareable lesson clips, teacher mode, paid Pro plan. No paid plan exists today and nothing is for sale.

## Data
Topics typed by the user are sent to the SlateMind server and to Groq, the AI provider that generates lessons. No accounts, no ads. AI output can contain mistakes.
